d: Platinum white hair flows in long, smooth waves reaching past the waist, paired with almond-shaped, gold-shaded eyes. The face appears mature and poised, set upon a slender build. The outfit consists of a deep red bodysuit and a matching pointed hat with gold embroidery, accented by a dark teal cloak and a gold-trimmed collar with green gems. A tall, dark staff with a carved head and a dangling teal key is held in one hand. BODY COLOR: pale white LEGS: plantigrade with flat feet enclosed in red and gold patterned boots
